tools.name: filter-events
tools.description: Filter events by date, genre and specials label. All filters are optional.

date.description: Optional. Date to filter events by. If omitted, search across all dates.

genre.description: Optional. Genres to filter events by. If omitted, search across all genres.

special.description: Optional. Special labels to filter events by. If omitted, search across all special labels.

tools.name: list_events_with_ticket-sales
tools.description: Look up shop_id and event_id for all events.

tools.name: list_tickets_for_event
tools.description: Look up ticket availability for a given event and shop.

tools.name: open_cart
tools.description: Opens the cart for a given shop.

tools.name: reserve_tickets
tools.description: Reserves tickets for a given ticket group and shop.

ticket_group_id.description: The ID of the ticket group to reserve tickets from.
